svg.aria-label: Twelve production projects by Suyash Potdar

g.text: 01 / OTT STREAMING APPLICATION
High-performance mobile video streaming app with instant offline playback and dynamic content catalogues.
Built with ultra-fast MMKV local caching, multi-factor auth, and scalable AWS CloudFront HLS video delivery.
REACT NATIVE · TYPESCRIPT · MMKV · AWS CLOUDFRONT · HLS · PAYMENT GATEWAY · ANALYTICS
02 / FINTECH LOAN ORIGINATION & CRM
End-to-end digital loan origination and customer onboarding mobile application.
Features automated KYC verification pipelines, document validation, and telecaller CRM multi-role approval workflows.
REACT NATIVE · TYPESCRIPT · NODE.JS · EXPRESS.JS · MONGODB · REST APIS · FINTECH
03 / LIVE SCORING CRICKET APPLICATION
Real-time cricket mobile application developed for the Bhojpuri Industry Premier League.
Engineered with low-latency WebSocket match broadcasts and Redis in-memory pub/sub for sub-second updates.
REACT NATIVE · SOCKET.IO · REDIS · ZUSTAND · NODE.JS · MONGODB · REALTIME
04 / NOVA AGENTIC AI PLATFORM
Autonomous AI agent platform orchestrating multi-step contextual reasoning, tool execution, and workflows.
Powered by local LLMs (Ollama, Qwen) with contextual RAG pipelines and conversational voice control.
LANGGRAPH · OLLAMA · QWEN · RAG · WEBSOCKETS · VECTOR DATABASES · AI AGENTS
05 / CUSTOMER SUPPORT PLATFORM
Multi-tenant customer support ticket platform featuring knowledge bases and agent triage workflows.
Provides a centralized management dashboard with automated issue assignment and priority categorization.
REACT · TYPESCRIPT · TAILWIND CSS · DOCKER · VITE · MULTI-TENANT
06 / EMBEDDABLE SUPPORT WIDGET SDK
Drop-in lightweight customer support SDK widget for web applications to integrate instant user assistance.
Optimized bundle size with zero external CSS leaks and bidirectional realtime event dispatching.
REACT · TYPESCRIPT · SDK ARCHITECTURE · WEBSOCKETS · NPM PACKAGE
07 / MONEY-MATE FINTECH ENGINE
Personal finance and expense management application with interactive analytics and categorization.
Enables users to track accounts, analyze monthly budget variance, and process automated receipts.
REACT NATIVE · NODE.JS · MONGODB · CHARTS · REST APIS
08 / CHATTR REAL-TIME MESSAGING
Sub-second real-time chat application with persistent message history and room authentication.
Scales across multiple server instances using Redis pub/sub socket adapter for high concurrency.
SOCKET.IO · REDIS · EXPRESS · NODE.JS · MONGODB · REALTIME
09 / QUIKLY SERVER MICROSERVICES
Production-ready backend API service with modular controller architectures and robust JWT security.
Includes data validation layers, Swagger OpenAPI documentation, and rate-limited endpoints.
NODE.JS · EXPRESS · MONGODB · JWT · SWAGGER · ZOD
10 / STOX FINANCIAL TRACKER
Stock and market portfolio intelligence dashboard with historical telemetry and trend analysis.
Connects to market data feeds to provide real-time valuation updates and watchlist alerts.
TYPESCRIPT · REACT · TAILWIND · CHART.JS · REST APIS
11 / EASE-MY-JOURNEY TRANSIT PLATFORM
Comprehensive bus and transit reservation system with seat selection and ticket generation.
Features multi-tier user authentication, payment processing, and administrative journey scheduling.
REACT NATIVE · NODE.JS · EXPRESS · MONGODB · PAYMENT GATEWAY
12 / GAN SYNTHESIS & MACHINE LEARNING PIPELINE
Generative Adversarial Network pipeline developed for synthetic image generation and evaluation.
Utilizes PyTorch and computer vision datasets with custom convolutional discriminator and generator blocks.
PYTHON · PYTORCH · GAN · DEEP LEARNING · COMPUTER VISION · JUPYTER
